goal: Prevent nodes using -privatebroadcast from deanonymizing themselves by resubmitting unconfirmed transactions
Avoids exposing transaction ownership over clearnet when the wider network drops a transaction
reviewability: Author replied to feedback on configuration coupling and documentation, awaiting reviewer response

Supports dropping wallet rebroadcast entirely under private broadcast (davidgumberg)

Concept approval without stated reasons (darosior, w0xlt)
